name: Take Back The Land
detailed_description:
Story

an open world Dark Fantasy themed game with witches, wizards, and all things magical, starring Hubey the man who lost his once taken land, is thrown into a jail cell with nowhere else to go. You must fight out of this jail cell, meet friends along the way, and most importantly take back your land.

Gameplay

In the world of "Lopani" there is plenty of things to do; Such as quests, find weapons, craft items, fight monsters, discover easter eggs/secrets, trading with witches in town, and even picking a fight with a random pedestrian in town, whatever you want is at the tip of your fingers. Just try to be careful as the knights don't take kindly to crime. The main character,

Hubey, also has a skill tree that is seperated into two sides, offense and defense. the more your offense is upgraded the more damage you do, and the better you are with small hasty weapons such as a short sword. The more your defense is upgraded the more health you

have, the better you become at dodging, and the better you become with heavier weapons, such as the Battle Axe and Great Sword. At the last 2 upgrades to your offense and defense you will only be able to max out one side fully, making you specialized in either offense or defense depending on what you choose.

  • Open world experience

  • 50+ different weapons

  • Multiple quests and side quests to enhance the gameplay

  • An intriguing story with multiple characters and lore

  • Multiple potions and spell related items to enhance the combat experience

  • A skill tree to upgrade Offense and Defense to keep the player strong as the game progresses and gets harder.

  • Interactive environment with civilians to talk to/pick a fight with.
